title:
This executor is a {@link SynchronousPyExecutor} that {@link #execute}s a {@link Workflow} in a simple serial fashion.
It uses a {@link SynchronousPyExecutionRepresentation} for its {@link WorkflowExecutionRepresentation} and a
{@link SimpleSynchronousPyRun} for its {@link WorkflowExecutorRun}.
name: SimpleSynchronousPyExecutor
